notes: New plugins target Plugin API 1.15.0; Plugin API 1.10-1.14 packages remain loadable.

Plugin API 1.15 distinguishes standalone workbench activities from true TOP workbenches. A TOP must align workspace.role/activity, window.activity, ctx.ui.activities.add(openMode: window), and ctx.ui.topWorkspace.register.
Viewport-owned scientific plots should use PluginWorkspace primaryScroll=contained with bounded height/min-height:0 layout ancestors to avoid intrinsic-size resize feedback loops.

Plugin API 1.15 Tool Workspaces reuse the TOP workspace/window lifecycle and are grouped under the Core Tools button; command-only Tools remain a lightweight form. Tool Workspace routing and dedicated-window Core Import forwarding require DK Data Studio 3.61.18 or newer.

Core Chart Runtime, ScientificPlot and ScientificCurveSurface provide display-only logarithmic scale toggles. XY/scatter/curve plots use |Y| on the Y axis; heatmaps/scalar fields use log10(|Z|) on the Z/color scale while X/Y coordinates remain unchanged. Source Artifacts and data exports are never mutated.
Plugin API 1.14 Core-owned per-workbench import actions and Plugin API 1.13 scoped source assignments remain the data-routing foundation.
Algorithm plugins are first-class versioned Algorithm Providers through analysis.algorithms and algorithmProvides.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.
